oe: Continuous monomolecular liquid-liquid emulsification
Hydrolytic ring-opening cleavage of cross-linked resin segments
The step-growth condensation rate profile acceleration via basic mineral salts
Mutual coagulation triggered when positively charged hide particles combine with negatively charged tannin colloids
oh: निरंतर एकल-आणविक द्रव-द्रव पायसीकरण (Liquid-liquid emulsification)
क्रॉस-लिंक्ड रेजिन खंडों का हाइड्रोलाइटिक रिंग-ओपनिंग विखंडन

Leather tanning colloid chemistry ka ek practical industrial application hai jo soft, decomposable raw animal hides ko colloidal charge neutralization ke through durable, imputrescible leather mein convert karta hai. Raw, un-tanned animal hide ek biological colloidal framework hai jo proteinaceous collagen fibers se bana hota hai jo net positive electrical surface charges carry karte hain. Vegetable Tannin (plant barks se obtained) aur synthetic chromium complexes water mein negatively charged colloidal dispersions form karte hain. Jab raw hides ko tannin ya chromium tanning bath mein soak kiya jata hai, toh positively charged collagen protein fibers aur negatively charged tannin colloids ke beech Mutual Coagulation (Mutual Precipitation) occur hoti hai. Ye unke surface charges ko neutralize karta hai aur protein chains ko cross-link kar deta hai, transforming the soft, putrescible raw hide into tough, hard, water-resistant, aur non-decomposable Leather. Modern commercial tanning vegetable tannins aur chrome tanning dono use karta hai (basic chromium sulfate salts, $Cr(OH)SO_4$ use karke), jo collagen carboxyl groups ke sath mutual coagulation aur chromium cross-linking produce karte hain.

• Option B is Correct because positively charged collagen fibers negatively charged chromium complexes ke sath mutual coagulation aur cross-linking karke leather ko harden banate hain.

• Option C is Incorrect because ring-opening reactions nylon synthesis ko characterize karte hain, collagen cross-linking ko nahi.

• Option D is Incorrect because step-growth condensation Dacron jaise polymerizations ko describe karta hai, tanning baths se unrelated hai.

qe: How does an industrial Cottrell precipitator successfully remove toxic soot and carbon smoke particles from factory chimney exhaust emissions?
qh: एक औद्योगिक कॉटरेल अवक्षेपक (Cottrell precipitator) कारखाने की चिमनी के निकास उत्सर्जन से जहरीली कालिख और कार्बन धुएं के कणों को सफलतापूर्वक कैसे हटाता है?
oe: By boiling the gas stream to convert carbon into volatile open-chain methane
By deploying cross-linked phenolic thermosetting network resins inside the flue gas
By passing the charged smoke particles through a high-voltage chamber containing oppositely charged plates, neutralizing and precipitating the soot
By transforming the aerosol into a water-soluble non-ionic carbohydrate grid
oh: कार्बन को वाष्पशील खुली श्रृंखला वाले मीथेन में बदलने के लिए गैस स्ट्रीम को उबालकर
फ्लू गैस के अंदर क्रॉस-लिंक्ड फेनोलिक थर्मोसेटिंग नेटवर्क रेजिन को तैनात करके
आवेशित धुएं के कणों को विपरीत आवेशित प्लेटों वाले उच्च-वोल्टेज कक्ष से गुजारकर, कालिख को उदासीन और अवक्षेपित करके
एरोसोल को पानी में घुलनशील गैर-आयनिक कार्बोहाइड्रेट ग्रिड में बदलकर
e:
Industrial factory chimneys se emit hone wala smoke ek solid-in-gas colloidal aerosol hota hai jisme unburnt carbon (soot), fly ash, aur dust particles hot flue gases mein suspended rehte hain. Ye particles ek electrical charge carry karte hain (commonly negative). Cottrell Smoke Precipitator electrostatic precipitation (electrophoresis followed by coagulation) utilize karta hai. Smoke stream ko ek chamber ke through direct kiya jata hai jisme smoke particles ki polarity ke opposite high-voltage wire electrodes maintain rehte hain at a potential difference of $30,000\text{ to }50,000\text{ Volts}$. Intense electric field gas ko ionize karta hai; jab charged colloidal soot particles oppositely charged collection electrode plates se strike karte hain, toh wo apna electrical charge lose kar dete hain, coagulate hote hain, aur gravity ke under hopper base par precipitate ho jaate hain, allowing clean, soot-free air to escape from the chimney stack. Frederick Gardner Cottrell dwara invent kiye gaye electrostatic precipitators thermal power stations mein fine particulate matter ($PM_{2.5}$ aur $PM_{10}$) ke liye $99\%$ se zyada collection efficiency achieve karte hain.

• Option A is Incorrect because exhaust gas ko heat karne se solid carbon chemical hydrogenation reagents ke bina methane gas mein convert nahi ho sakta.

• Option B is Correct because high-voltage oppositely charged plates charged smoke particles ko neutralize aur precipitate kar deti hain.

• Option C is Incorrect because smoke water-soluble carbohydrates mein chemically convert nahi ho sakta.

• Option D is Incorrect because Bakelite jaise thermosetting network resins flue gas precipitators ke roop mein deploy nahi kiye jaate.

qe: Which analytical testing method allows a chemical technician to definitively determine which phase is the dispersed phase versus the dispersion medium inside an unknown emulsion sample?
qh: कौन सी विश्लेषणात्मक परीक्षण विधि एक रासायनिक तकनीशियन को निश्चित रूप से यह निर्धारित करने की अनुमति देती है कि एक अज्ञात पायस (emulsion) नमूने के भीतर कौन सा चरण बिखरा हुआ चरण (dispersed phase) बनाम फैलाव माध्यम (dispersion medium) है?

Verifying if the material undergoes rapid free-radical coordination transformations
Measuring the cross-linking density of the methylene bridges under pressure
Dilution testing: adding excess dispersion medium blends smoothly, while adding excess dispersed phase separates into a distinct isolated layer
oh: नमूने को सधूम नाइट्रिक एसिड आसवन मार्गों के अधीन करना
यह सत्यापित करना कि क्या सामग्री तेजी से मुक्त-कण समन्वय परिवर्तनों से गुजरती है
दबाव में मेथिलीन पुलों के क्रॉस-लिंकिंग घनत्व को मापना
तनुकरण परीक्षण (Dilution testing): अतिरिक्त परिक्षेपण माध्यम मिलाने पर वह आसानी से मिल जाता है, जबकि अतिरिक्त परिक्षेपित प्रावस्था मिलाने पर वह एक अलग पृथक परत में विभाजित हो जाता है

Emulsion ek liquid ka dusre immiscible liquid mein colloidal dispersion hota hai, categorized into Oil-in-Water (O/W, jaise milk) ya Water-in-Oil (W/O, jaise butter/cold cream). Dilution Test phase continuity par based ek diagnostic method hai:

- Emulsion ko uske continuous Dispersion Medium ka additional volume add karke kisi bhi extent tak dilute kiya ja sakta hai, jo emulsion ko break kiye bina smoothly blend ho jata hai;

- Agar Dispersed Phase ko excess mein add kiya jata hai, toh wo continuous phase dwara homogeneously absorb nahi ho pata aur ek distinct, immiscible layer mein separate ho jata hai.

For example, O/W emulsion (jaise milk) mein water add karne par ye smoothly dilute hota hai, par oil add karne par floating layer ban jati hai. Conversely, W/O emulsion added oil ke sath homogeneously mix hota hai par excess water add karne par phase separation cause karta hai. Emulsion type identify karne ke dusre standard tests mein Conductivity Test (continuous aqueous phase ke kaaran O/W electricity well conduct karta hai; W/O non-conductive hota hai) aur Dye Test (Sudan III jaise oil-soluble dye W/O emulsions ko completely color karte hain) shamil hain.

• Option A is Incorrect because fuming nitric acid ek destructive oxidizing agent hai jo organic lipids ko decompose kar deta hai emulsion type diagnose karne ke bajaye.

• Option B is Correct because Dilution Test ke zariye continuous medium smoothly mix ho jata hai jabki dispersed phase separate layer bana leta hai.

• Option C is Incorrect because methylene bridge density phenolic resins par apply hoti hai, fluid emulsions par nahi.

• Option D is Incorrect because free-radical coordination synthetic polymer kinetics se relate karta hai.

qe: Why do physical adsorption (physisorption) and chemical adsorption (chemisorption) show opposite trends when the system operational temperature is raised?
qh: प्रणाली के परिचालन तापमान को बढ़ाने पर भौतिक अधिशोषण (physisorption) और रासायनिक अधिशोषण (chemisorption) विपरीत प्रवृत्तियाँ क्यों दिखाते हैं?
oe: There is no operational difference; both follow identical exothermic thresholds
Physisorption is an open open-chain carbohydrate mesh, while chemisorption is a phenolic network
Physisorption relies on weak van der Waals forces that break easily at high temperatures, whereas chemisorption requires activation energy to form chemical bonds and is initially favored by heat
Physisorption is driven by strong ionic links that fracture under heat
oh: कोई परिचालन अंतर नहीं है; दोनों समान ऊष्माक्षेपी सीमाओं का पालन करते हैं
भौतिक अधिशोषण एक खुली श्रृंखला कार्बोहाइड्रेट जाल है, जबकि रासायनिक अधिशोषण एक फेनोलिक नेटवर्क है

भौतिक अधिशोषण कमजोर वांडर वाल्स बलों पर निर्भर करता है जो उच्च तापमान पर आसानी से टूट जाते हैं, जबकि रासायनिक अधिशोषण के लिए रासायनिक बंध बनाने हेतु सक्रियण ऊर्जा की आवश्यकता होती है और प्रारंभ में गर्मी इसके अनुकूल होती है
भौतिक अधिशोषण मजबूत आयनिक बंधों द्वारा संचालित होता है जो गर्मी के तहत टूट जाते हैं
e:
Solid surfaces par gases ka adsorption Physisorption (non-specific van der Waals forces dwara driven) aur Chemisorption (valence chemical bond formation dwara driven) mein classified hota hai:

- **Physisorption**: Weak, non-directional van der Waals forces involve karta hai aur nearly zero activation energy require karta hai. Kyunki adsorption exothermic ($\Delta H < 0$) hota hai, Le Chatelier's Principle ke according temperature raise karne se adsorbed gas molecules ki thermal kinetic energy increase hoti hai, promoting desorption. Isliye physisorption temperature ke sath continuously aur monotonically decrease hota hai.

- **Chemisorption**: Strong covalent ya coordinate surface bonds form karna involve karta hai ($\Delta H = 80-240\text{ kJ/mol}$). Ek chemical reaction ki tarah, ye ek significant Activation Energy ($E_a$) require karta hai. Temperature raise karne par is activation barrier ko overcome karne ke liye thermal energy supply hoti hai, causing chemisorption to initially increase to a peak before declining at very high temperatures due to desorption.

Physisorption ke liye $\frac{x}{m}$ vs $T$ ka isobaric plot continuous downward slope show karta hai, jabki chemisorption ek initial rise ke baad decline exhibit karta hai, highlighting why chemisorption is termed 'Activated Adsorption'.

• Option A is Incorrect because physisorption low enthalpy ($20-40\text{ kJ/mol}$) ke sath weak non-ionic van der Waals interactions se characterize hota hai.

• Option B is Correct because physisorption weak forces ke break hone se temperature badhne par ghatata hai, jabki chemisorption activation energy barrier ke karan initially heat se promote hota hai.

• Option C is Incorrect because ye invalid structural polymer claims describe karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because ye activation thermodynamics ko ignore karta hai.

The trace stabilizing electrolytes are completely stripped away, destroying the surface charges and triggering rapid coagulation
The continuous medium turns entirely volatile and boils away into gas
The entire mixture converts into an open-chain dicarboxylic acid fragment

ट्रेस स्थिर करने वाले विद्युत-अपघट्य (electrolytes) पूरी तरह से छिन जाते हैं, जिससे सतह के आवेश नष्ट हो जाते हैं और तीव्र स्कंदन (coagulation) शुरू हो जाता है
निरंतर माध्यम पूरी तरह से वाष्पशील हो जाता है और गैस में उबल जाता है
पूरा मिश्रण एक खुली श्रृंखला वाले डाइकार्बोक्सिलिक एसिड टुकड़े में बदल जाता है
e:
Dialysis ek colloidal purification technique hai jisme dissolved crystalloid electrolyte impurities semi-permeable parchment ya cellophane membrane ke through colloidal sol se bahar diffuse ho jaati hain. Jabki electrolytes ki excessive concentrations sol coagulation cause karti hain, dissolved electrolyte ka ek trace amount electrical double layer, surface charge, aur zeta potential maintain karne ke liye fundamentally indispensable hota hai jo colloidal particles ko mutually repulsive aur stable rakhta hai. Agar dialysis excessively prolonged period ke liye carry out ki jaye, toh ye essential trace stabilizing electrolytes bhi membrane ke through diffuse out ho jaate hain. Apne surface electrical charge se deprive hone par, colloidal particles electrostatic repulsion lose kar dete hain aur aggregate hokar spontaneous coagulation, flocculation, aur precipitation undergo karte hain. Electrodialysis ionic impurities ke removal ko accelerate karne ke liye external electric field apply karta hai, par ise bhi complete de-electrolyzation aur sol destabilization avoid karne ke liye carefully time kiya jana chahiye.

• Option B is Correct because prolonged dialysis se essential trace electrolytes remove ho jaate hain, jisse surface charge destroy hokar rapid coagulation trigger ho jata hai.

• Option C is Incorrect because dialytic diffusion chemical bonds ko dicarboxylic acid fragments mein cleave nahi karta.

• Option D is Incorrect because dialysis ambient temperatures par conduct ki jaati hai aur solvent boiling cause nahi karti.

qe: Why does a white precipitate of a silver halide turn into a colored solid mass when exposed to an aqueous solution containing the dye eosin?
qh: सिल्वर हैलाइड का एक सफेद अवक्षेप (white precipitate) ईोसिन डाई युक्त जलीय घोल के संपर्क में आने पर रंगीन ठोस द्रव्यमान में क्यों बदल जाता है?
oe: Because it forms a highly volatile open-chain carbohydrate mesh under heat
Because the colored dye molecules undergo selective surface adsorption onto the silver halide crystal faces
Because the treatment converts the halide ions into narrow-spectrum antibiotics
Because the dye dissolves the silver lattice completely via basic mineral buffering
oh: क्योंकि यह गर्मी के तहत अत्यधिक वाष्पशील खुली श्रृंखला कार्बोहाइड्रेट जाल बनाता है
क्योंकि रंगीन डाई के अणु सिल्वर हैलाइड क्रिस्टल चेहरों पर चयनात्मक सतही अधिशोषण (selective surface adsorption) से गुजरते हैं
क्योंकि उपचार हैलाइड आयनों को संकीर्ण-स्पेक्ट्रम एंटीबायोटिक्स में परिवर्तित करता है
क्योंकि डाई बुनियादी खनिज बफरिंग के माध्यम से चांदी के जालक को पूरी तरह से घोल देती है
e:
Adsorption indicators organic dyes hote hain jo precipitation titrations ke dauran precipitate lattice par surface adsorption hone ke kaaran stoichiometric equivalence point reach karne par color change karte hain (Fajans' method). Jab silver ions ko halide ions ke against Eosin ya Fluorescein jaise adsorption indicator ki presence mein titrate kiya jata hai, toh silver halide ka white precipitate (e.g., $AgCl$ ya $AgBr$) form hota hai. Equivalence point ke theek baad, precipitate particles excess $Ag^+$ ions adsorb kar lete hain, acquiring a positive surface charge. Ye positively charged crystal faces phir eosin dye ke colored organic anions ko electrostatic surface adsorption ke through selectively adsorb kar lete hain. Crystal boundary par dye molecules ka ye concentration dye ke chromophore resonance ko alter karta hai, turning the white precipitate into a distinct colored (pink/red) solid mass. Kasimir Fajans ne argentometric precipitation titrations mein adsorption indicators (Fluorescein, Eosin, Rhodamine) introduce kiye the, jo entirely surface adsorption dynamics par rely karte hain.

• Option A is Incorrect because silver halide crystal lattice ek insoluble precipitate ke roop mein intact rehta hai aur dye dwara dissolve nahi hota.

• Option B is Correct because colored dye molecules silver halide precipitate surface par selectively adsorb hokar use color provide karte hain.

• Option C is Incorrect because ye unrelated carbohydrate transformation describe karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because ye antibiotic transformation describe karta hai jo is context se completely irrelevant hai.

qe: What surface chemical mechanism allows a moist lump of alum to quickly stop bleeding when rubbed over a minor skin cut?
qh: कौन सा सतही रासायनिक तंत्र फिटकरी (alum) के एक नम टुकड़े को मामूली त्वचा कटने पर रगड़ने से रक्तस्राव को जल्दी रोकने की अनुमति देता है?
oe: The alum dissolves the red blood cells into a volatile gas phase configuration
It alters the internal molecular weight of water molecules up to infinite thresholds
It transforms the vascular boundary walls into unbranched synthetic polyolefins
The highly charged aluminum cations in alum induce the rapid coagulation of the negatively charged colloidal blood particles, forming a clot plug
oh: फिटकरी लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं को वाष्पशील गैस चरण विन्यास में पूरी तरह से घोल देती है
यह पानी के अणुओं के आंतरिक आणविक भार को अनंत सीमाओं तक बदल देता है
यह संवहनी सीमा दीवारों को अशाखित सिंथेटिक पॉलीओलेफ़िन में बदल देता है
फिटकरी में मौजूद अत्यधिक आवेशित एल्युमिनियम धनायन ऋणावेशित कोलाइडल रक्त कणों के तेजी से स्कंदन (coagulation) को प्रेरित करते हैं, जिससे एक थक्का प्लग बनता है
e:
Human blood plasma mein suspended cellular elements (erythrocytes, leukocytes, platelets) aur colloidal proteins (albumin, globulin, fibrinogen) se bana ek negatively charged biological colloidal sol hai. Potash Alum [$K_2SO_4 \cdot Al_2(SO_4)_3 \cdot 24H_2O$] aur Ferric Chloride ($FeCl_3$) powerful styptic agents ki tarah act karte hain. Jab alum ka moist lump bleeding cut par apply kiya jata hai, toh ye locally dissolve hokar trivalent Aluminium cations ($Al^{3+}$) release karta hai. Hardy-Schulze Rule ke according, kyunki $Al^{3+}$ high positive charge (valency of 3) carry karta hai, ye colloidal blood proteins aur cellular fragments par present negative surface electrical charges ko rapidly neutralize kar deta hai. Electrostatic repulsion se strip hone ke baad, blood rapidly coagulate hokar ek insoluble gelatinous fibrin clot banata hai jo damaged capillary ko plug kar deta hai aur bleeding arrest karta hai. Blood par electrolytes ki coagulating efficiency Hardy-Schulze valency order follow karti hai: $Al^{3+} > Fe^{3+} > Ca^{2+} > Na^+$, jo explain karta hai ki kyun alum ($Al^{3+}$) styptic agent ke roop mein table salt ($Na^+$) se far superior hai.

• Option A is Incorrect because alum blood cells ko inorganic salts ke contact par aane par chemically gases mein dissolve nahi karta; ye unhe aggregate aur precipitate karwata hai.

• Option B is Correct because alum ke $Al^{3+}$ cations negatively charged colloidal blood particles ko neutralize aur coagulate karke clot plug bana dete hain.

• Option C is Incorrect because ye impossible polymer claim describe karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because ye molecular weight alteration ka impossible claim describe karta hai.

qe: What happens to the internal mechanical structure of raw animal hides when they are soaked inside a chromium salt tanning bath?
qh: कच्ची पशु खाल (raw animal hides) की आंतरिक यांत्रिक संरचना का क्या होता है जब उन्हें क्रोमियम सॉल्ट टैनिंग बाथ के भीतर भिगोया जाता है?
oe: The structural chains are broken completely down into single amino units
The positively charged hide fibers undergo mutual coagulation with the tanning complexes, inducing robust cross-linking that hardens the matrix into leather
The functional domains are reduced to water-soluble linear starch granules
The entire matrix converts into an amorphous non-ionic carbohydrate project
oh: संरचनात्मक श्रृंखलाएं पूरी तरह से एकल अमीनो इकाइयों में टूट जाती हैं
धनावेशित खाल के रेशे टैनिंग कॉम्प्लेक्स के साथ पारस्परिक स्कंदन (mutual coagulation) से गुजरते हैं, जिससे मजबूत क्रॉस-लिंकिंग प्रेरित होती है जो मैट्रिक्स को चमड़े में कठोर कर देती है
कार्यात्मक डोमेन पानी में घुलनशील रैखिक स्टार्च कणिकाओं में कम हो जाते हैं
पूरा मैट्रिक्स एक अनाकार गैर-आयनिक कार्बोहाइड्रेट परियोजना में परिवर्तित हो जाता है
e:
Leather manufacturing mutual coagulation ke colloidal principle par rely karti hai, jahan oppositely charged colloidal systems ko mix karke simultaneous charge neutralization aur precipitation induce kiya jata hai. Raw animal hide ek colloidal matrix hai jo proteinaceous collagen fibers se bani hoti hai jo net positive electrical surface charges carry karte hain. Basic Chromium Salts (jaise chrome tanning mein use hone wala basic chromium sulfate, $Cr(OH)SO_4$) aur vegetable tannins water mein negatively charged coordination complexes ya colloidal sols form karte hain. Jab raw hides ko chromium tanning bath mein immerse kiya jata hai, toh positively charged collagen protein chains aur negatively charged chromium complexes ke beech Mutual Coagulation aur Cross-linking occur hoti hai. Ye cross-linking collagen triple-helices ko bridge karti hai, transforming the soft, putrescible raw hide into tough, heat-resistant, aur chemically durable Leather. Chrome tanning chromium(III) ions aur collagen ke carboxylate ($-COO^-$) side chains ke beech coordinate covalent bridges introduce karta hai, dramatically increasing hydrothermal stability (shrinkage temperature $> 100^\circ\text{C}$).

• Option A is Incorrect because tanning collagen networks ko preserve aur stabilize karti hai peptide chains ko amino acids mein hydrolyze karne ke bajaye.

• Option B is Correct because positively charged collagen fibers negatively charged chromium complexes ke sath mutual coagulation aur cross-linking karke leather ko harden banate hain.

• Option C is Incorrect because ye non-protein carbohydrate transformation describe karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because ye starch transformation ka irrelevant claim describe karta hai.

qe: According to the Hardy-Schulze rule, why does a trivalent phosphate anion ($PO_4^{3-}$) exhibit a dramatically greater coagulating power than a monovalent chloride anion ($Cl^-$)?
qh: हार्डी-शुल्ज़ नियम के अनुसार, एक त्रिसंयोजक फॉस्फेट ऋणायन ($PO_4^{3-}$) एक एकसंयोजक क्लोराइड ऋणायन ($Cl^-$) की तुलना में नाटकीय रूप से अधिक स्कंदन क्षमता (coagulating power) क्यों प्रदर्शित करता है?
oe: The phosphate configuration is a natural biopolymer that dissolves instantly in water
The phosphate ion completely lacks oxygen atoms within its framework
The coagulating power scales sharply with the valency of the counter-ion, and the higher $-3$ charge of phosphate neutralizes sols far more efficiently than the $-1$ charge of chloride
Phosphate contains an abundance of volatile ester functional groups
oh: फॉस्फेट विन्यास एक प्राकृतिक बायोपोलीमर है जो पानी में तुरंत घुल जाता है
फॉस्फेट आयन में इसके ढांचे के भीतर ऑक्सीजन परमाणुओं की पूरी तरह से कमी होती है
स्कंदन क्षमता विरोधी आयन (counter-ion) की संयोजकता के साथ तेजी से बढ़ती है, और फॉस्फेट का उच्च $-3$ आवेश क्लोराइड के $-1$ आवेश की तुलना में सॉल को अधिक कुशलता से उदासीन करता है
फॉस्फेट में वाष्पशील एस्टर कार्यात्मक समूहों की प्रचुरता होती है
e:
Added electrolyte dwara colloidal sol ka coagulation ya precipitation Hardy-Schulze Rule se govern hota hai, jo active counter-ion ke ionic charge aur uski coagulating efficacy ke beech relationship define karta hai. Hardy-Schulze Rule do key tenets establish karta hai:

1. Colloidal particles ke charge ke opposite charge carry karne wala ion (active counter-ion) coagulation cause karne ke liye responsible hota hai;

2. Active ion ki coagulating (flocculating) power uski valency (charge, $z$) ke fourth power ke directly proportional hoti hai: $\text{Coagulating Power} \propto z^4$

Positively charged sol (jaise hydrated ferric oxide sol) ke liye, coagulation anions dwara drive hota hai. Kyunki trivalent Phosphate anion ($PO_4^{3-}$, valency 3) monovalent Chloride anion ($Cl^-$, valency 1) ke comparison mein $-3$ charge carry karta hai, iski theoretical coagulating power $Cl^-$ se approximately $3^4 = 81\text{ times}$ greater hoti hai. Is tarah $PO_4^{3-}$ ke liye required minimum concentration (coagulation value) far smaller hoti hai. Positive sols ke liye anions ki coagulating power sequence: $[Fe(CN)_6]^{4-} > PO_4^{3-} > SO_4^{2-} > Cl^-$, jabki negative sols (jaise $As_2S_3$) ke liye cation sequence $Al^{3+} > Ba^{2+} > Na^+$ hoti hai.

• Option A is Incorrect because inorganic orthophosphate ions ($PO_4^{3-}$) zero organic ester functional groups contain karte hain.

• Option B is Correct because higher valency ($-3$) ke karan phosphate ion monovalent chloride ($-1$) ki tulna mein exponentially greater coagulating power exhibit karta hai.

• Option C is Incorrect because phosphate ion $PO_4^{3-}$ hota hai, jisme 4 oxygen atoms hote hain.

• Option D is Incorrect because phosphate ek simple tetrahedral inorganic oxyanion hai, biopolymer nahi.

qe: What structural feature characterizes the continuous zig-zag path of colloidal particles observed under an ultra-microscope?
qh: अल्ट्रा-माइक्रोस्कोप के तहत देखे गए कोलाइडल कणों के निरंतर टेढ़े-मेढ़े मार्ग (continuous zig-zag path) की क्या संरचनात्मक विशेषता है?
oe: It represents an open-chain carbohydrate mesh supported by glycosidic blocks
It represents a single-stranded linear array of unbranched volatile oligomers
It is an amorphous cross-linked three-dimensional network held by sulfur links
It is the Brownian movement driven by the constant kinetic impact of highly active dispersion medium molecules against the colloidal cores
oh: यह ग्लाइकोसिडिक ब्लॉकों द्वारा समर्थित एक खुली श्रृंखला कार्बोहाइड्रेट जाल का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है
यह अशाखित वाष्पशील ओलिगोमर्स की एकल-फंसे रैखिक सरणी का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है
यह सल्फर लिंक द्वारा आयोजित एक अनाकार क्रॉस-लिंक्ड तीन-आयामी नेटवर्क है
यह अत्यधिक सक्रिय परिक्षेपण माध्यम के अणुओं द्वारा कोलाइडल कोर पर निरंतर गतिज प्रभाव द्वारा संचालित ब्राउनियन गति (Brownian movement) है
e:
Jab kisi colloidal solution ko concentrated beam of light se illuminate karke ultramicroscope (Zsigmondy, 1903) ke under beam path ke perpendicular observe kiya jata hai, toh colloidal particles ek continuous, chaotic dance execute karte hue bright pinpoints of light ke roop mein appear hote hain. Ultramicroscope ke under observe hone wala continuous, erratic, aur unpredictable zig-zag trajectory Brownian Movement hai. Ye physical motion colloid ke chemical nature par depend nahi karta, balki liquid dispersion medium ke fast-moving thermal molecules dwara colloidal cores ke against deliver kiye gaye continuous, random, aur unbalanced kinetic collisions se entirely drive hota hai. Kyunki $1-1000\text{ nm}$ range ke particles par sabhi sides se lagne wale impacts instantaneously cancel out nahi hote, particle randomly knock hota rehta hai. Smaller particle size aur lower medium viscosity faster Brownian motion produce karti hain. Brownian movement matter ki kinetic molecular theory ko confirm karta hai aur explain karta hai ki kyun colloidal sols gravity ke under settle hue bina indefinitely suspended rehte hain.

• Option A is Incorrect because observed phenomenon dynamic physical particle motion hai, stationary linear oligomeric array nahi.

• Option B is Correct because ye dispersion medium molecules ke continuous kinetic impact dwara driven Brownian movement hai.

• Option C is Incorrect because vulcanized rubber networks ko describe karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because polysaccharide carbohydrate gels ko describe karta hai.

qe: Which specific organic functional group is generated when the carboxyl group of one amino acid condenses with the amino group of an adjacent unit to build a protein?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक कार्यात्मक समूह तब उत्पन्न होता है जब एक अमीनो एसिड का कार्बोक्सिल समूह प्रोटीन बनाने के लिए आसन्न इकाई के अमीनो समूह के साथ संघनित होता है?
oe: Sulfur disulfide cross-link system anchoring paths
Glycosidic connection bridging rings together
Peptide linkage / Amide bond
Phosphodiester coordinate bridge balancing frames
oh: सल्फर डाइसल्फाइड क्रॉस-लिंक प्रणाली जो पथों को एंकर करती है
ग्लाइकोसिडिक संबंध (Glycosidic connection) जो छल्लों को आपस में जोड़ता है
पेप्टाइड लिंकेज / एमाइड बंध (Peptide linkage / Amide bond)
फॉस्फोडिएस्टर समन्वय पुल जो फ्रेम को संतुलित करता है
e:
Proteins high-molecular-weight biological polymers hote hain jo directional condensation reactions ke through join kiye gaye twenty standard $\alpha$-amino acids ki linear chains se construct hote hain. Jab ek $\alpha$-amino acid ka carboxylic acid group ($-COOH$) adjacent amino acid ke amino group ($-NH_2$) ke sath react karta hai, toh condensation process mein water molecule ($H_2O$) eliminate ho jata hai. Resulting covalent functional group jo do amino acid residues ke beech form hota hai, use Amide Linkage ($-CO-NH-$) kehte hain, jise biochemistry mein specifically Peptide Linkage (ya Peptide Bond) designate kiya jata hai. Is peptide condensation ko repeat karne se linear polypeptide backbones banti hain jo functional proteins mein fold hoti hain. Carbonyl oxygen aur amide nitrogen ke beech resonance ke kaaran peptide bond mein partial double-bond character ($\approx 40\%$) hota hai, jo $-CO-NH-$ unit ko planar, rigid, aur rotation ke prati resistant banata hai.

• Option A is Incorrect because glycosidic bonds ($-C-O-C-$) carbohydrates (jaise starch aur glycogen) mein monosaccharide units ko connect karte hain.

• Option B is Correct because amino acid condensation se covalent amide bond ($-CO-NH-$) banta hai jise peptide linkage kehte hain.

• Option C is Incorrect because DNA/RNA mein nucleotides ko link karne wale $3',5'$-phosphodiester bonds ko describe karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because tertiary protein structures mein cysteine residues ke beech form hone wale disulfide bridges ($-S-S-$) ko describe karta hai.

qe: What precise modern structural and chemical definition is assigned to the macro-class of materials known as carbohydrates?
qh: कार्बोहाइड्रेट के रूप में जाने जाने वाले सामग्रियों के व्यापक वर्ग को दी गई सटीक आधुनिक संरचनात्मक और रासायनिक परिभाषा क्या है?
oe: Suicidal competitive enzyme inhibitors with irreversible networks
Optically active polyhydroxy aldehydes or ketones, or compounds yielding them upon hydrolysis
Optically inactive linear aromatic hydrocarbons with single bonds
Unbranched non-ionic long-chain potassium fatty acid salts
oh: अपरिवर्तनीय नेटवर्क के साथ आत्मघाती प्रतिस्पर्धी एंजाइम अवरोधक
प्रकाशिक रूप से सक्रिय पॉलीहाइड्रॉक्सी एल्डिहाइड या कीटोन, या ऐसे यौगिक जो जल-अपघटन पर इन्हें उत्पन्न करते हैं
एकल बंध वाले प्रकाशिक रूप से अक्रिय रैखिक एरोमैटिक हाइड्रोकार्बन
अशाखित गैर-आयनिक लंबी श्रृंखला वाले पोटेशियम फैटी एसिड लवण
e:
Carbohydrates ki historical definition as 'hydrates of carbon' [$C_x(H_2O)_y$] abandon kar di gayi thi kyunki acetic acid ($C_2H_4O_2$) jaise non-carbohydrates formula mein fit hote hain, jabki rhamnose ($C_6H_{12}O_5$) aur deoxyribose ($C_5H_{10}O_4$) jaise authentic carbohydrates isme fit nahi hote. Modern biochemistry Carbohydrates (Saccharides) ko unke functional structure ke base par strictly define karti hai as: Optically active polyhydroxy aldehydes (Aldoses, e.g., D-glucose) ya polyhydroxy ketones (Ketoses, e.g., D-fructose), ya aise complex substances jo chemical/enzymatic hydrolysis par ye basic units yield karte hain (jaise sucrose, maltose, starch, aur cellulose). Ye multiple alcohol groups ($-OH$) aur ek carbonyl carbon ($-CHO$ ya $>C=O$) contain karte hain, jisme asymmetric carbons optical activity impart karte hain. Carbohydrates complexity ke hisab se Monosaccharides (further hydrolyze nahi ho sakte), Oligosaccharides (2–10 monosaccharide units yield karte hain), aur Polysaccharides (complete hydrolysis par hundreds se thousands monosaccharide units yield karte hain) mein classify kiye jaate hain.

• Option A is Incorrect because carbohydrates multiple chiral carbon centers contain karne wale aliphatic oxygenated biomolecules hote hain, jo unhe optically active banate hain.

• Option B is Correct because carbohydrates optically active polyhydroxy aldehydes, ketones, ya unke hydrolytic precursors hote hain.

• Option C is Incorrect because soft potassium soaps ko describe karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because irreversible enzyme poisons ko describe karta hai.

qe: What architectural spatial arrangement characterizes the alpha-helix conformation commonly encountered in the secondary structure of proteins?
qh: प्रोटीन की माध्यमिक संरचना में आमतौर पर सामना किए जाने वाले अल्फा-हेलिक्स विन्यास की कौन सी संरचनात्मक स्थानिक व्यवस्था विशेषता है?
oe: Individual strands lying parallel to each other held by broad inter-chain linkages
A continuous polypeptide chain coiled tightly into a right-handed screw geometry stabilized by hydrogen bonds
An open open-chain carbohydrate mesh locked by loose glycosidic units
A cross-linked network layer centered around a quaternary nitrogen group
oh: व्यापक अंतर-श्रृंखला लिंकेज द्वारा आयोजित एक दूसरे के समानांतर पड़ी व्यक्तिगत किस्में
हाइड्रोजन बंधों द्वारा स्थिर एक दाहिने हाथ की पेंच (right-handed screw) जैसी ज्यामिति में कसकर कुंडलित एक सतत पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला
ढीली ग्लाइकोसिडिक इकाइयों द्वारा बंद एक खुली श्रृंखला कार्बोहाइड्रेट जाल
चतुर्धातुक नाइट्रोजन समूह के आसपास केंद्रित एक क्रॉस-लिंक्ड नेटवर्क परत
e:
Proteins ki secondary structure polypeptide backbone ke localized spatial conformation ko refer karti hai, jo predominantly $\alpha$-helices ya $\beta$-pleated sheets mein fold hoti hai (Linus Pauling aur Robert Corey, 1951). $\alpha$-Helix conformation mein, ek single linear polypeptide chain regularly ek tight, right-handed (clockwise) screw-like helical coil mein twist hoti hai. Ye spatial geometry regular Intramolecular Hydrogen Bonds dwara stabilize hoti hai jo spiral turn ke along har amino acid residue ($n$) ke carbonyl oxygen ($-C=O$) aur fourth amino acid residue ($n+4$) ke amide hydrogen ($-NH-$) ke beech form hote hain. $\alpha$-helix ke har turn mein approximately 3.6 amino acid residues hote hain with a pitch of $0.54\text{ nm}$, aur sabhi bulky amino acid side chains ($R$-groups) outward project karte hain. $\alpha$-keratin (jo hair, wool, aur nails mein paya jata hai) jaise fibrous proteins almost entirely right-handed $\alpha$-helices se consist hote hain jo protofibrils mein aapas mein twist rehte hain.

• Option A is Incorrect because $\beta$-pleated sheet conformation ko describe karta hai, jahan extended polypeptide chains inter-chain hydrogen bonds se side-by-side hold hoti hain.

• Option B is Correct because single continuous chain right-handed screw geometry mein coil hokar regular hydrogen bonds dwara stabilize hoti hai.

• Option C is Incorrect because amylose jaise polysaccharide carbohydrate chains ko describe karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because synthetic quaternary ammonium surfactant networks ko describe karta hai.

qe: Which specific organic compound is generated when D-glucose undergoes complete chemical reduction using hydrogen iodide ($HI$) under thermal conditions?
qh: जब D-गुकलोज थर्मल स्थितियों के तहत हाइड्रोजन आयोडाइड ($HI$) का उपयोग करके पूर्ण रासायनिक अपचयन से गुजरता है तो कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक उत्पन्न होता है?
oe: Pentaacetylated glucose crystal matrix
n-Hexane unbranched straight-chain alkane
Saccharic acid containing terminal dicarboxylic groups
Gluconic acid monocarboxylic derivative sheet
oh: पेंटाएसिटिलेटेड ग्लूकोज क्रिस्टल मैट्रिक्स
$n$-हेक्सेन ($n$-Hexane) अशाखित सीधी श्रृंखला वाला एल्केन
टर्मिनल डाइकार्बोक्सिलिक समूहों वाला सैकेरिक एसिड
ग्लूकोनिक एसिड मोनोकार्बोक्सिलिक व्युत्पन्न शीट
e:
D-glucose ki open-chain structure ko deduce karne ke liye historically specific reagents ke sath chemical reactions use kiye gaye the (Emil Fischer). Jab D-Glucose ($C_6H_{12}O_6$) ko $100^\circ\text{C}$ ($373\text{ K}$) par red phosphorus ki presence mein concentrated Hydrogen Iodide ($HI$) ke sath prolonged heating di jaati hai, toh ye complete deoxygenation aur chemical reduction undergo karta hai: $CHO-(CHOH)_4-CH_2OH + 14HI \xrightarrow{\text{Red P}, \Delta} CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-CH_3\text{ (}n\text{-Hexane)} + 6H_2O + 7I_2$

$n$-Hexane (ek saturated, unbranched straight-chain 6-carbon alkane) ka formation definitive experimental proof provide karta hai ki glucose ke sabhi six carbon atoms ek continuous, unbranched straight chain mein aapas mein linked hain. Glucose ki key diagnostic reactions: $HI/P \to n\text{-hexane}$ (straight chain proof); $Br_2\text{ water} \to \text{gluconic acid}$ (aldehyde group proof); $Ac_2O \to \text{pentaacetate}$ (five $-OH$ proof); $HNO_3 \to \text{saccharic acid}$ (primary alcohol proof).

• Option A is Incorrect because saccharic acid (ek dicarboxylic acid) glucose ke concentrated nitric acid ($HNO_3$) ke sath strong oxidation se banta hai.

• Option B is Correct because complete reduction se 6-carbon unbranched straight-chain alkane $n$-hexane prapt hota hai.

• Option C is Incorrect because gluconic acid bromine water ($Br_2/H_2O$) ke sath mild oxidation se banta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because glucose pentaacetate acetic anhydride ke sath acetylation se banta hai.

qe: What happens to the structure of a carbohydrate like starch or cellulose when it undergoes complete biochemical digestion in a living organism?
qh: जब एक जीवित जीव में स्टार्च या सेलुलोज जैसे कार्बोहाइड्रेट का पूर्ण जैव रासायनिक पाचन होता है तो उसकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
oe: It cross-links into an insoluble three-dimensional thermosetting network
It undergoes hydrolytic cleavage of its glycosidic linkages to release single monosaccharide sugar units like glucose
It forms a volatile uncharged non-polar polyolefin tail grid
It converts into fuming nitric acid vapors inside cellular channels
oh: यह एक अघुलनशील तीन-आयामी थर्मोसेटिंग नेटवर्क में क्रॉस-लिंक करता है
यह ग्लूकोज जैसी एकल मोनोसैकेराइड शर्करा इकाइयों को छोड़ने के लिए अपने ग्लाइकोसिडिक लिंकेज के हाइड्रोलाइटिक विखंडन (जल-अपघटन) से गुजरता है
यह एक वाष्पशील अनावेशित गैर-ध्रुवीय पॉलीओलेफ़िन टेल ग्रिड बनाता है
यह कोशिकीय चैनलों के अंदर सधूम नाइट्रिक एसिड वाष्प में परिवर्तित हो जाता है
e:
Complex dietary carbohydrates (polysaccharides) energy reserves (plants mein starch, animals mein glycogen) ya structural scaffolds (cellulose) ke roop mein function karte hain. Ye repeating monosaccharide rings se bane polymers hote hain. Starch aur Cellulose high-molecular-weight polysaccharides hain jo $\alpha$-1,4- (aur $\alpha$-1,6-) ya $\beta$-1,4-Glycosidic Bonds se joined thousands of D-glucose units se bane hote hain. Biochemical digestion ke dauran, digestive hydrolytic enzymes (jaise salivary/pancreatic amylase, maltase, aur ruminants mein symbiotic cellulases) ether bridges ke across water add karke in glycosidic linkages ka Hydrolytic Cleavage catalyze karte hain: $(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + nH_2O \xrightarrow{\text{Enzymatic Hydrolysis}} nC_6H_{12}O_6\text{ (D-Glucose)}$

Ye polymer ko individual monomeric D-glucose molecules mein break down karta hai, jo cellular ATP production ke liye glycolysis mein enter karte hain. Humans amylase use karke starch ($\alpha$-glycosidic bonds) ko digest kar sakte hain, par cellulose ko digest nahi kar sakte kyunki human digestive enzymes $\beta$-1,4-glycosidic linkages ko hydrolyze karne ke liye cellulase lack karte hain (acting instead as dietary fiber/roughage).

• Option A is Incorrect because digestion ek catabolic breakdown process hai, industrial thermosetting cross-linking reaction nahi.

• Option B is Correct because digestive enzymes glycosidic linkages ko hydrolyze karke single monosaccharide units (jaise glucose) release karte hain.

• Option C is Incorrect because impossible chemical decomposition pathways ko describe karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because volatile polyolefin generation ka impossible claim describe karta hai.

qe: Which operational catalyst enzyme decomposes the disaccharide maltose into two clean units of D-glucose inside chemical channels?
qh: कौन सा परिचालन उत्प्रेरक एंजाइम रासायनिक चैनलों के भीतर डिसेकेराइड माल्टोज़ को डी-ग्लूकोज की दो स्वच्छ इकाइयों में विघटित (decomposes) करता है?
oe: Urease nitrogen clearing module
Invertase sugar clearing fluid
Pepsin proteolytic enzyme
Maltase
oh: यूरिएस नाइट्रोजन शोधन मॉड्यूल
इन्वर्टेज शर्करा शोधन तरल
पेप्सिन प्रोटियोलिटिक एंजाइम
माल्टेस (Maltase)
e:
Disaccharides do monosaccharide units se bane compound sugars hote hain. Digestive tract aur yeast mein specific hydrolytic enzymes in units ko link karne wale glycosidic bonds ko cleave karte hain. Maltase intestinal juice (succus entericus) aur yeast mein produce hone wala specialized biocatalytic enzyme hai jo Maltose (malt sugar, $C_{12}H_{22}O_{11}$) ko hydrolyze karta hai. Maltose ek reducing disaccharide hai jisme do $\alpha$-D-glucose units ek $\alpha(1\to 4)$ glycosidic bond se joined hoti hain. Maltase is bond ko specifically target karta hai, cleaving one molecule of maltose into two identical molecules of D-Glucose: $C_{12}H_{22}O_{11}\text{ (Maltose)} + H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{Maltase}} 2C_6H_{12}O_6\text{ (D-Glucose)}$

Common disaccharide digestive enzymes: Maltase (Maltose $\to$ Glucose + Glucose), Lactase (Lactose $\to$ Glucose + Galactose), aur Sucrase/Invertase (Sucrose $\to$ Glucose + Fructose).

• Option A is Incorrect because Invertase (Sucrase) sucrose ko D-glucose aur D-fructose ke equimolar mixture mein hydrolyze karta hai.

• Option B is Correct because Maltase enzyme specifically maltose disaccharide ko do D-glucose units mein break down karta hai.

• Option C is Incorrect because Pepsin ek gastric protease hai jo proteins ko proteoses aur peptones mein digest karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because Urease urea ko ammonia aur carbon dioxide mein hydrolyze karta hai.

qe: What direct mechanical change occurs to the native protein architecture inside an egg white when it undergoes thermal coagulation upon boiling?
qh: जब एक अंडे की सफेदी को उबालने पर थर्मल जमावट (thermal coagulation) होती है, तो उसके भीतर की प्राकृतिक प्रोटीन संरचना में क्या सीधा यांत्रिक परिवर्तन होता है?
oe: The native hydrogen bonds are disrupted, causing structural globules to unfold and helices to uncoil, resulting in a loss of biological activity
The carbon backbone converts into a volatile open-chain gas cloud
The covalent peptide linkages are broken, returning the protein to single units
The functional domains are reduced to non-ionic starch granules
oh: प्राकृतिक हाइड्रोजन बंध टूट जाते हैं, जिससे संरचनात्मक ग्लोब्यूल्स खुल जाते हैं और हेलिक्स खुल जाते हैं, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप जैविक गतिविधि का नुकसान होता है (विकृतीकरण)
कार्बन रीढ़ एक वाष्पशील खुली श्रृंखला वाली गैस क्लाउड में परिवर्तित हो जाती है
सहसंयोजक पेप्टाइड लिंकेज टूट जाते हैं, जिससे प्रोटीन एकल इकाइयों में लौट आता है
कार्यात्मक डोमेन गैर-आयनिक स्टार्च कणिकाओं में कम हो जाते हैं
e:
Apni native state mein, protein ke paas ek unique, folded 3D conformation (secondary, tertiary, aur quaternary levels) hoti hai jo hydrogen bonds, ionic bonds, aur van der Waals forces jaise weak non-covalent interactions se stabilized hoti hai. Jab soluble globular Ovalbumin contain karne wale egg white ko boil kiya jata hai, toh thermal kinetic energy delicate intramolecular hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic interactions ko disrupt kar deti hai. As a consequence, tightly folded globular protein unfold ho jata hai, $\alpha$-helices aur $\beta$-sheets uncoil ho jaati hain, aur exposed linear polypeptide chains randomly entangle ho jaate hain. Ye aapas mein cross-link hokar ek insoluble, opaque, white solid gel coagulum (Denaturation of Protein) bana lete hain, completely and irreversibly destroying its native biological activity. Protein denaturation ke dauran (heat, pH changes, ya heavy metals dwara), secondary aur tertiary structures destroy ho jaati hain, par primary structure (peptide backbone) intact rehti hai.

• Option A is Incorrect because denaturation strong covalent peptide bonds ($-CO-NH-$) ko cleave nahi karta; primary amino acid sequence completely intact rehti hai.

• Option B is Correct because thermal boiling se hydrogen bonds toot jaate hain, structural globules unfold ho jaate hain aur protein denature ho jata hai.

• Option C is Incorrect because ye impossible gas cloud decomposition ko describe karta hai.

• Option D is Incorrect because protein starch granules mein convert nahi ho sakta.
